title: Element events
description: The events `<glyph-plot>` dispatches (REQ-EVENT-010): bubbling, composed CustomEvents named `plot-…`, each with a `detail` of the shape in `$defs`. A document here is `{ "type": "plot-…", "detail": … }`, the event's type and its detail, as the contract and the Node tests record them. The reader-action events (hover, select, brush, view, legend, cursor) fire only for the reader's actions, never for a property the page set (REQ-VIEW-040), and carry `source`. The wasm module writes these details as one JSON string when its input call reports events pending.

detail.description: The event's detail, of the shape `type` names.

range.description: A range [low, high] in data units.

datum.description: The datum's row: column name to value, as the data table shows it (numbers stored, timestamps in epoch ms, categories and strings as labels, missing as null).

x.description: The datum's x in data units (epoch ms for time), or its category label on a band scale.

plot-ready.description: A chart's first frame was drawn (REQ-EL-120).

plot-error.description: Loading the chart or drawing its first frame failed (REQ-EL-120).

message.description: The error's message, as `there is no chart named "<type>"`.

plot-hover.description: The datum under the cursor changed (REQ-EVENT-020): at most once an animation frame, null when the cursor leaves the plot.

index.description: The snapped datum's row in the data as held now.

y.description: The snapped datum's y in data units, or null when it is missing.

aggregate.description: When the dot column holds more than one datum, the column's summary of y (REQ-HIT-020); otherwise null.

first.description: The y of the column's first datum.

last.description: The y of the column's last datum.

cell.description: The cell the cursor is in.

plot-select.description: The reader clicked, tapped or pressed Enter on a datum.

y.description: The selected datum's y, or null when it is missing.

plot-brush.description: The reader brushed a range or cleared one; x and y both null is a cleared brush.

x.description: The brushed x range, or null.

y.description: The brushed y range, or null.

count.description: Data inside the brush; 0 when cleared.

final.description: False while the brush is being dragged, true when it is committed or cleared.

plot-view.description: The reader panned, zoomed, reset or followed (REQ-EVENT-030): at most once an animation frame during a gesture with `final` false, and exactly once with `final` true when it ends.

final.description: True on the gesture's last event (pointer up, wheel idle 150 ms, key up, motion done).

view.description: The view state after the change; a page may set it on a linked chart as it is.

visible.description: Whether the series is now shown.

hidden.description: Every hidden series after the toggle, as the view's `hidden`.

plot-cursor.description: The reader locked, unlocked or stepped a locked cursor: the event a page listens to for a scrub that drives other content.

x.description: The cursor's x in data units, or null when it is gone.

locked.description: Whether the cursor is now locked.

plot-data.description: A commit of data took effect (REQ-STREAM-070): after each replace and each frame's coalesced appends.

dropped.description: Rows trimmed from the ring by `retain.rows` or `retain.age` in this commit.

late.description: Appended rows dropped because their x was less than the last row's (REQ-STREAM-040).

version.description: The data version, increasing by one each commit.
